| # Global Fail safe Command (GFC) {#global-fail-safe-command-gfc-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                     |                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The Global Fail safe Command(GFC) is a feature from the CiA-304 specification. The GFC may be used to speed up the system reaction. If at least one transmission has been received, the GFC shall be valid already. It allows only one reaction in a CAN network. For that reason, the usage of the GFC is optional. It is event-driven only and not safe (no periodic time expectation).

Example: After a safety-relevant change at a device input, the GFC may be transmitted optionally first. Then the corresponding SRDO shall follow to maintain safety.
